description: Get the daily weather forecast for a city between start_date and end_date: minimum and maximum temperature, conditions, chance of rain and humidity. How many days ahead the forecast reaches depends on the weather service and can be only a few days: a start_date after its last day returns error_code out_of_range with coverage_end, the last day it covers, and a range partly after it returns the covered days with unavailable_dates. Tell the user the forecast isn't available yet for those days. An unknown place returns an error (newer servers add error_code city_not_found): ask the user which city they mean. Use when the user asks about the weather at their destination during a trip, whatever they travel by. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: End date for forecast in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional)

start_date.description: Start date for forecast in YYYY-MM-DD format

name: weather_forecast
title: Destination weather
